scope: B06-04 E07 lines 220–311 scoped local only

groups.contract: Inputs detector and original candidates list; annotations are descriptive. Invoke E03 first for retained chronology identity and non-null dirty; discard returned time. A falsey candidates value delegates detector._compute_reconciliation(candidates) with no keywords and returns element zero directly, not a copied list. No E07 evidence, cache lookup, insertion or reopen catch on this route. Provider effects still occur (accepted set replacement, lineage/output bookkeeping); empty input is not a no-op.

Set-comprehend physical Order pairs (order_first_index,order_break_index) without conversion, deduplicate using native equality/hash; sort distinct pairs ascending lexicographically before reads. For each, get current order_audit entry once; ledger tuple in order: entry is not None, identity in initial_order_audit, bool(entry and entry.get('order_b_causes')), frozenset(entry.get('causes',())) if entry else (). Initial membership is independent of current presence. Empty mapping is present but falsey, with false Order_B flag and empty tuple, distinct from a truthy entry with empty frozenset causes. Cause iteration/hash errors propagate; cause sequence order and duplicates are discarded by frozenset. This is selected evidence, not full audit contents or validation of geometry.

Traverse original candidate order, no sort. For each derive physical pair again; form six-field dependency in order: repr(zone), ledger[order], result of gate-owned blocking callback, sequence_priority(parent_type,'red'), then same callback with 'blue', parent_source_index iff parent_type equals 'E' else source_index. repr is native dataclass representation including Decimal representations, not normalized serialization; no comparison of zone solely by repr. Gate and priority calls happen even on future exact hit; no coercion of callback results. Only after tuple succeeds, group by source_index using setdefault and append; group order is first encounter, row order original candidates. A new empty list argument is evaluated even for existing group. Parent-index evidence distinguishes earlier E-parent races; other types use own source.

Iterate detector.s_zones in supplied order. For each source_index, setdefault group then append tuple of source_time, a_source_time, decision_event_time, color, read in order. No price, physical object identity, sorting or deduplication added; setdefault may create an empty group before field evaluation fails. Parent consistency is conditional.

Freeze complete reset mapping item pairs (both key and value), then invalid S identities and current visual lifecycle starts in separate frozensets. Evidence is ordered tuple (grouped dictionary, parents dictionary, resets, validity pair); dict/list contents are not recursively frozen. Scope is (detector.direction, detector._live_scope), separate from E02 market scope. Exact key ordered five components: tuple(map(id,candidates)) in input order (duplicates retained), tuple of (source,tuple(rows)) for grouped items in insertion order, analogous parent tuples, resets, validity. No direct scope, dirty timestamp, chronology identity, full ledger, candles or callback identity in exact key; these are distinct from selected evidence and generation scope. Ordinary hash/equality; exact identity list plus repr and selected evidence is not proof of semantic equivalence for all external inputs. Snapshot is assembled before native replay and before cache restoration.

Evaluate current exact map get first; Python or evaluates previous exact map get only if current result falsey. Native _ReconciledE is truthy; distinction from E06 None-only lookup matters for malformed values. Final selected non-None object triggers hit even if falsey previous. No dirty cutoff or scope gate on exact hit. Write selected record into current exact map then current scoped map; replace detector._last_candidate_zones with fresh list(saved.candidates), replace accepted identities with fresh set(saved.accepted), union saved.lifecycle_starts into existing visual set (not replacement), return fresh list(saved.numbered). Contents are same element references, not deep copies; no native compute, audit rebuild or native-numbered restoration here. Earlier writes remain if later conversion, update or return allocation fails; no rollback.

On exact miss fetch previous scoped record by scope; allocate fresh steps, frontier=0, checkpoint=None in order. Only non-None previous and equality previous.evidence[3] == validity enter rewind. Unpack previous evidence exactly four elements; use detector._main_index(self._dirty) with fresh dirty attribute read (not E03 result). Provider delegates chronology.main_index(value,clamp=True). Validity mismatch keeps prior object for later call, but no rewind/checkpoint and frontier zero. No new previous-scope entry is stored here.

Iterate union of new/old group keys (set order not guaranteed). Lookup old then new with empty-list defaults. Compare ordered lists; difference lowers frontier via min(frontier, source, every last field of each row from old+new concatenation); deletion, addition and changed order/evidence all qualify. Last field is E parent index or own source, not a time. Iterate union of S parent keys; compare new then old get with None defaults; difference lowers frontier to source only. Iterate symmetric difference of complete reset (instant,value) pairs, not just timestamps; map each instant through _main_index, minimize. A changed reset value may map same instant twice. No explicit zero clamp after min; normal comparable index contract and valid evidence required. Min result order-independent for native ints, but dynamic calls/errors can depend on set iteration.

Left bisect previous.steps by step.source, target frontier; requires source-ordered steps. Copy prefix slice before position into fresh steps via extend (shared step references). If position < len(previous.steps), choose that step, not previous preceding step. Else choose last previous step and pop final retained element so checkpoint is replayed rather than duplicated. No guard against empty steps: indexing fails before try; no local verification of sortedness or step counts. Native E44 records steps in heap order of minimum source time, decision event time, source index and appends terminal len(candles) step; monotone source indices and consistency with time mapping are conditional, not established by bisect itself.

Try encompasses first _compute_reconciliation(candidates,steps=steps,checkpoint=checkpoint,previous=previous,frontier=frontier) and exact two-item result unpack. Original candidates passed, same mutable steps, previous even on validity mismatch. Catch only _ReopenedERace (including subclass), clear steps in place, retry with candidates and steps only; defaults checkpoint=None,previous=None,frontier=0. Retry outside protected body, second reopen or any other error propagates. No rollback of detector mutations, maps or callback effects from first attempt, only steps cleared. Native E44 sets accepted set and resets reopened flag before traversal; checkpoint-specific reopen at 1311–1312 precedes that branch's fresh _zone call, not proof of no earlier mutation. Native candidate list may be copied on first generated candidate; original caller list remains distinct from internal expanded list.

After successful compute/unpack, test truthiness of detector._reconciliation_reopened. Only falsey flag constructs _ReconciledE: tuple of original caller candidates, tuple of numbered output, frozenset of detector accepted identities, frozenset visual lifecycle starts, original precompute evidence tuple, tuple(steps), native returned object unchanged (native provider returns tuple). Arguments evaluated in order; record frozen/slotted but nested dict/list evidence and element references shallow. Native E44 emits terminal step then native tuple before StopAll parent_type projection; numbered output distinct from native continuation tuple. A truthy flag skips both writes and does not invalidate older exact/scoped entries.

Chained assignment stores same saved reference in current exact map first, current scoped map second. No previous-map mutation or transaction; second write failure leaves first. Return numbered object directly on compute route, not tuple or fresh copy, even when reopened and unsaved. Contrast exact hit returns newly allocated numbered list. Exceptions from evidence, hash/equality, rewind, non-reopen compute, retry, flag, construction and write propagate; no general rollback. No cross-owner acceptance or native active-cache inference.

supplemental.prior_interpretation: Presence versus truthiness; red before blue priority; original candidate order.
Key retains group insertion order and object IDs; accepted set replaced, lifecycle set unioned.
Previous passed even on validity mismatch; terminal fallback assumes nonempty ordered steps.

validation.method: Pinned source-first local contracts; exact canonical/historical seven arrays and AST nodes, filter suffix resolution, all CP317 canonical category/index/id/span plus W1 crosswalk site/span and partition membership, previous three registers row identity and historical W1 text/disposition and supplements, current partition historical W1 matches, complete 25-partition disjoint union. Existing inventories only.

findings.description: Revalidated B06-04-F1: distinguish empty current audit mapping versus absent and empty tuple versus frozenset; exact evaluation order, dependency grouping, exact-key versus scope and restoration.

Revalidated B06-04-F2: qualify bisect ordering and nonempty terminal step, previous passed even on mismatch, first-call exception scope, limited steps clear, partial effects and shallow save; no native live activation claim.

limitations: Separate source-first local forensic review by GPT, not independently staffed. Existing AST inventories directly compared, not regenerated.

Local source-only scope; no RAW payload, runtime, ZIP, production/main change, new cross-owner acceptance or empirical cache equivalence. Uploaded operating protocol's historical ZIP/runtime requirements superseded by explicit source-only scope and repository AGENTS.

Prior 694 category row identities, operations, spans, historical W1 dispositions/interpretations and eight supplemental identities checked against pinned artifacts; not runtime validation or new semantic acceptance of the prior partitions. All 1109 CP317 links checked against canonical inventory, W1 crosswalk and partitions; all 25 historical partition link sets not independently refetched in CP413 (four reviewed partitions checked).

Native provider assumptions include stable source-index/time alignment, source-ordered nonempty checkpoints, comparable/hashable evidence and valid dirty scope. No claim arbitrary callback/key equivalence, or that malformed inputs are reachable.
Publication readback is Git identity and exact content comparison, not independent SHA-256 or signature verification.
